title: Morning Window
poem:
Morning leans against the glass
And paints the quiet room with gold
A sparrow stitches through the sky
While rooftops wake from dreams of cold

title: Library Rain
poem:
Rain taps softly on the roof
As pages turn beneath my hand
Each sentence opens up a door
To somewhere strange and grand

title: Small Seed
poem:
A seed sleeps under patient earth
And gathers strength from rain
One green thought lifts its tiny head
And finds the sun again

title: Blue Bicycle
poem:
My blue bicycle hums downhill
Past gardens bright with summer air
The wind unties my hurried thoughts
And leaves them dancing everywhere

title: Evening Tea
poem:
The kettle sings its silver song
The evening folds the day away
A cup of warmth between my hands
Makes room for what I could not say

title: The Moon's Note
poem:
The moon leaves one pale note of light
Upon the river's moving page
The water carries it downstream
Beyond the bridge, beyond the age

title: Campus Path
poem:
Old trees shade the campus path
New footsteps cross their roots
A thousand plans begin to grow
Beside the sound of boots

title: Paper Boat
poem:
I made a boat from yesterday's news
And set it in the stream
It sailed beneath the willow leaves
Like a small and floating dream

title: After the Bell
poem:
The classroom empties into dusk
Chairs rest in a crooked line
Outside, the first stars take their seats
And make the dark seem kind

title: Window Garden
poem:
Basil reaches for the sun
Mint wanders past its pot
A little green unruly place
Turns a windowsill to plot

title: Cloud Shapes
poem:
A cloud becomes a sailing ship
Then changes into wool
The sky keeps drawing while I watch
A picture never full

title: Quiet Courage
poem:
Courage does not always roar
Sometimes it is a knock
A question asked, a first small step
A key turned in a lock

title: City Dawn
poem:
The buses yawn along the street
Shop shutters blink awake
The baker sets warm loaves in rows
As daylight fills the lake

title: Old Photograph
poem:
A photograph holds summer still
Though years have hurried by
We laugh again in paper light
Beneath a younger sky

title: Footprints
poem:
The shore erases every step
Then welcomes one more trace
The tide can take the marks away
But not the walking place

title: The Kite
poem:
A red kite pulls against the wind
And climbs above the field
I hold the string and learn at last
That letting go can yield

title: Night Train
poem:
The night train gathers distant towns
Like beads upon a thread
I count the lamps that drift away
And dream above my bed

title: First Draft
poem:
The first line stumbles from my pen
The next one finds its feet
A poem grows by trying again
Until the words can meet

title: Autumn Bench
poem:
One copper leaf rests on the bench
Beside my folded coat
The trees let go without a sound
And trust the wind to float

title: Helpful Hands
poem:
One hand steadies the leaning stack
Another shares the load
The road feels shorter when we walk
 Together down the road

title: Moon Lantern
poem:
The moon is a lantern hung above the sleeping town.
The river is a ribbon carrying pieces of its light.
Night pulls a dark blue curtain across the hills.
Morning lifts that curtain with two bright hands.

title: Notebook Boat
poem:
My notebook is a small boat on a wide sea of thought.
Each blank page is a harbor waiting for a name.
My pencil is an oar that searches for a shore.
A sentence drops its anchor when it feels like home.

title: Heart Garden
poem:
My heart is a garden behind a quiet gate.
Kind words are rain that wake the buried seeds.
Worry is a thorn that tangles in the path.
Hope is a green door opening toward the sun.

title: Clockwork River
poem:
The clock is a river carrying our hours away.
Its silver hands are two fish turning in circles.
I place one wish beside the stream.
The current keeps it glowing as it travels.

title: City Orchestra
poem:
The city is an orchestra tuning up at dawn.
Buses are brass notes rolling down the avenue.
Shop doors clap their hands to greet the day.
The traffic is a drum beneath our hurried feet.

title: Winter Blanket
poem:
Winter lays a white blanket over the fields.
The sleeping grass keeps summer folded underneath.
Bare branches are dark fingers writing on the sky.
Spring will read their message in green.

title: Library Forest
poem:
The library is a forest made of paper trees.
Every book is a path through someone else's world.
I follow a sentence like a lantern through the leaves.
The final page is a clearing full of light.

title: Voice of Rain
poem:
Rain is a patient drummer on the roof.
Each drop is a quiet syllable in the evening song.
The window wears a necklace of water.
The whole house listens without a word.

title: Brave Step
poem:
Fear is a locked room at the end of the hall.
Courage is a key I make from one small step.
The door swings open into morning.
My shadow walks beside me, smaller than before.

title: Autumn Letter
poem:
Autumn is a letter written in copper leaves.
The wind is its messenger crossing the park.
Each tree sends one last golden word.
The ground keeps every line until spring.

title: Quiet Sea
poem:
Silence is a blue sea inside my room.
My thoughts are little boats drifting across it.
One bright idea becomes a lighthouse.
It guides the others safely back to shore.

title: Music Box
poem:
The song is a bird asleep inside the piano.
A key turns, and its wings open wide.
The melody becomes a golden thread.
It stitches distant hearts together.
